article.title: Parentesco social coreano vs términos familiares españoles
article.part: Contraste y dominio C2 — 대조와 C2 고급 운용
article.chapter: Interferencias del español de Guatemala — 과테말라 스페인어의 간섭

claims.summary: Kim’s analysis describes the spread of Korean family-derived address terms beyond family relationships in modern Korean and discusses this as a sociolinguistic pattern; it does not establish a one-to-one equivalent with Guatemalan Spanish kinship words.

locator.section: Kim (2003), abstract, lines 95–101; bibliographic details, lines 158–181.
locator.htmlLines: Kim (2003), abstract, lines 95–101; bibliographic details, lines 158–181.

links.notes: The study identifies family-derived address terms outside the family and proposes social and linguistic factors; its scope is modern Korean address usage.
